# Flower Lifestyle — Florist in Kenya

> Fresh flower delivery in Nairobi and across Kenya. Same-day bouquets, M-Pesa payments, City Market florist shop.

- [Website](https://www.flowerlifestyle.co.ke)
- [Email](mailto:flowerlifestyle@gmail.com)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/flowerlifestyle_giftshop/)

## Primary Services
- Same-day flower delivery in Nairobi (CBD, Westlands, Karen, Kilimani, Eastlands, Thika Road)
- Countrywide flower delivery in Kenya (on request)
- Birthday, anniversary, romance, roses, sympathy, Mother's Day, money bouquets
- M-Pesa, cash, and card payments
